title: How do I post a Club Membership late fee charge?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Club Membership late fee charge: when it applies and how to post it.

## Applicable situation
A late fee charge applies when a scheduled recurring dues charge fails to collect and the membership is marked past due. The amount actually billed is determined by this policy's own governing basis for the late fee charge.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked and then called: charge_late_fee_8963437d.

## Parameters
- membership_id: identifies the contract to be billed; find this via a prior lookup of the member's own membership holdings.
- customer_id: identifies the member behind that contract; also available from the member's profile or membership holdings.
- amount_usd: the late fee figure, stated in US dollars to exactly 2 decimal places; always required, and never a negative number.

## Return
A successful call confirms the new entry's own reference number and restates which contract and dollar figure were billed. If no such contract is on file, the call's return text says so instead of raising an error.

## Points of judgement
A second call to charge_late_fee_8963437d for what was really the same missed-payment event does not overwrite the first; it simply adds another, independent late-fee entry.
